bugs.bug: nvm_list_aliases and nvm_ls use `unsetopt local_options nomatch` / `markdirs`, which unsets the local_options option itself instead of setting nonomatch/nomarkdirs locally, so the user's zsh options are clobbered and not restored
bugs.example: nvm.sh: `unsetopt local_options nomatch` turns off local_options and nomatch globally rather than disabling nomatch for the function, so the caller's zsh options are changed and not restored on return
